connector.name: Email Inbox API + Sending by Sendmux
connector.registryDescription: AI email inbox and sending tools with attachments, search, live events, and webhooks.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.sendmux.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package sendmux-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sendmux account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SENDMUX_MAILBOX_API_KEY
env.description: Mailbox API key for Mailbox API and Sending API tools.

env.name: SENDMUX_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY
env.description: Root API key for Management API tools.

env.name: SENDMUX_SENDING_API_KEY
env.description: Optional send-capable smx_mbx_ key or owner-approved smx_agent_ token for Sending API tools when it differs from the Mailbox API key.
